description: RFC 8707 Resource Indicators for OAuth 2.0 — conformance test vectors.

resource_parameter.name: resource
resource_parameter.note: If present, the aud claim in the issued token MUST include the resource URI

aud_binding_vectors.description: Authorization with resource indicator → aud is [base_audience, resource_uri]
Authorization without resource indicator → aud is a single base string
Resource indicator preserved through token refresh rotation
aud_binding_vectors.spec: RFC 8707 §2 — resource binding MUST persist across token refresh
